{{Quote|I've diverted the ship to the Tynna sector. We received a Red Zero call and I thought you'd really want to respond. An extra day or so isn't going to make any difference to the survival rate of casualties now.|[[Gett]], to [[Etain Tur-Mukan]]|<ref name="RC" />}}
The '''Tynna sector''', also known as the '''Tynnan sector''',<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] containing [[Allanteen VI/Legends|Allanteen Six]], [[Kelarea]], and [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]].
